name: Violetmod
description: A unified, modular Geometry Dash toolkit for Geode with gameplay, diagnostics, editor and performance modules.

ui-theme.name: Color theme
ui-theme.description: Choose the accent color used by Violetmod.

ui-compact.name: Compact layout
ui-compact.description: Use a denser layout with less spacing.

ui-button-label.name: Menu button text
ui-button-label.description: Text shown on the main-menu shortcut. Keep it short.

feature-frame-counter.name: Enable Frame Counter
feature-frame-counter.description: Counts PlayLayer update frames since the current gameplay session started.

feature-hitbox-viewer.name: Enable Hitbox Viewer
feature-hitbox-viewer.description: Enables the feature when its implementation is available.

feature-trajectory.name: Enable Show Trajectory
feature-trajectory.description: Enables the feature when its implementation is available.

compat-safe-mode.name: Safe mode
compat-safe-mode.description: Disables experimental Violetmod modules when implemented.

feature-speedhack.name: Speedhack
feature-speedhack.description: Implemented as a Practice Mode-only update-delta multiplier; disabled by Safe Mode.

feature-speedhack-audio.name: Speedhack audio sync
feature-speedhack-audio.description: Preference only; module implementation is pending.

feature-noclip.name: Noclip (local practice)
feature-noclip.description: Preference only; module implementation is pending.

feature-limit-noclip.name: Limit Noclip
feature-limit-noclip.description: Preference only; module implementation is pending.

feature-layout-mode.name: Layout mode
feature-layout-mode.description: Preference only; module implementation is pending.

feature-show-hitboxes.name: Show hitboxes
feature-show-hitboxes.description: Planned: true collision-shape visualization; not enabled until engine collision bounds are hooked.

feature-show-hitbox-trail.name: Show hitbox trail
feature-show-hitbox-trail.description: Planned: records and displays collision-shape history.

feature-show-trajectory.name: Show trajectory
feature-show-trajectory.description: Planned: predicts and draws player movement using validated game physics.

feature-smart-startpos.name: Smart StartPos
feature-smart-startpos.description: Planned: automatic management of practice checkpoints.

feature-startpos-switcher.name: StartPos switcher
feature-startpos-switcher.description: Planned: switch between saved practice checkpoints.

feature-show-all-attempts.name: Show all attempts
feature-show-all-attempts.description: Preference only; module implementation is pending.

feature-no-glow.name: No glow
feature-no-glow.description: Preference only; module implementation is pending.

feature-no-shaders.name: No shaders
feature-no-shaders.description: Preference only; module implementation is pending.

feature-pitch-shifter.name: Pitch shifter
feature-pitch-shifter.description: Preference only; module implementation is pending.

feature-frame-extrapolation.name: Frame extrapolation
feature-frame-extrapolation.description: Preference only; module implementation is pending.

physics-tps.name: Physics TPS target
physics-tps.description: Requested simulation tick rate; actual support depends on the game engine.

fps-lock-value.name: FPS target
fps-lock-value.description: A target cannot guarantee rendered frames beyond device and engine limits.

auto-safe-mode.name: Automatic safe mode
auto-safe-mode.description: Planned compatibility fallback for unstable modules.

label-fps.name: Label: FPS
label-fps.description: Displays an update-rate estimate from PlayLayer timing; it is not a hardware refresh-rate measurement.

label-tps.name: Label: TPS
label-tps.description: Displays measured PlayLayer update calls per second; this is not a separate physics-step counter.

label-physics-tps.name: Label: Physics TPS
label-physics-tps.description: Not implemented yet: a true physics-step counter requires a separate engine physics hook.

label-frame-time.name: Label: Frame time
label-frame-time.description: Displays the latest PlayLayer update delta in milliseconds.

label-attempts.name: Label: Attempts
label-attempts.description: Displays the current level attempt count.

label-session-time.name: Label: Session time
label-session-time.description: Displays elapsed time since the gameplay session overlay was initialized.

label-speed.name: Label: Speed multiplier
label-speed.description: Displays the configured speed multiplier value; it does not activate speedhack.

label-player-x.name: Label: Player X position
label-player-x.description: Displays the primary player's current X position.

label-player-y.name: Label: Player Y position
label-player-y.description: Displays the primary player's current Y position.

label-player-mode.name: Label: Player mode
label-player-mode.description: Display preference; overlay implementation is pending.

label-practice-status.name: Label: Practice status
label-practice-status.description: Displays whether the current run is in Practice or Normal mode.

label-clicks.name: Label: Input display
label-clicks.description: Displays the current level click counter.

label-memory.name: Label: Memory usage
label-memory.description: Display preference; overlay implementation is pending.

label-device-refresh-rate.name: Label: Display refresh rate
label-device-refresh-rate.description: Display preference; overlay implementation is pending.

feature-verify-hack.name: Verify Hack (UNVERIFIED upload)
feature-verify-hack.description: Allows the supported upload flow to mark an eligible unverified level as UNVERIFIED. Never represents it as verified.

feature-all-copyable.name: All Copyable (GD 2.2)
feature-all-copyable.description: Uses the current Geometry Dash 2.2 copy workflow; not a password bypass.

verify-hack-marker.name: Unverified description marker
verify-hack-marker.description: Text appended to the level description when using Verify Hack.

label-frame-counter.name: Label: Frame counter
label-frame-counter.description: Displays the number of PlayLayer updates since the current gameplay session started.
